description: This file defines a generic surrogate serializer class SurrogateCodec that implements serialization, deserialization, deep copy, and related operations for types TField using surrogate types TSurrogate and a converter TConverter. It is part of the Orleans serialization infrastructure, handling custom serialization logic via surrogates.

classes.name: SurrogateCodec
classes.description: A generic surrogate serializer class supporting deep copying, serialization, and deserialization for types TField via surrogate types and converters.

methods.name: SurrogateCodec
methods.description: Constructor initializing serializers, copiers, and converters for the surrogate codec.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the input object, utilizing surrogate conversion and copying.

methods.description: Deserializes a value from the reader, handling references and surrogate conversion.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a field with surrogate conversion, handling reference tracking and type checks.

methods.description: Serializes the object into the writer using surrogate conversion.
